test.name: GPS review of an existing proof routes to the gps-mentor agent, not this skill
test.description: The mid-research-flynn scenario already has ps_001 (parentage, probable). The user asks whether that EXISTING proof meets the Genealogical Proof Standard. Per the ruling on issue #1861, review of an existing proof is the gps-mentor agent's job, not proof-conclusion's: proof-conclusion writes a conclusion and has no review step in its body, so a review request landing here re-runs the conclusion instead of assessing it. This is an empty-correct_skill negative rather than a `correct_skill: ["gps-mentor"]` one because `correct_skill` entries are gate-checked against real skill DIRECTORIES (runnability.py) and gps-mentor is a plugin agent with none — and because the harness's routing signal is `skills_invoked`, which an Agent delegation never enters. So the assertion is: no skill fires, and the request is handed to the mentor. Was a positive review-mode test before #1861; the user_message is unchanged so the utterance stays pinned in the trigger corpus.

input.user_message: Does my proof for the parentage question (ps_001) meet the Genealogical Proof Standard? Assess the EXISTING ps_001 against the five GPS components — judge it on the evidence it actually cites. Any sources or assertions that exist in research.json but are NOT cited in ps_001 are evidence GAPS for the next round of work (after they're extracted/classified) — flag them and say whether they would change the tier, but do NOT frame them as defects, failures, or premature reasoning of the current proof. Treat ps_001 as it stands.

negative.explanation: Assessing an existing ps_NNN against the five GPS components is a review, and the reviewer is the read-only gps-mentor agent (`@plugin:gps-mentor`, focus `on-demand`). proof-conclusion must not fire: its body resolves the request to one q_ id and delegates to the proof-conclusion agent to CONCLUDE, which would re-run the conclusion the user asked to have reviewed, and at tier >= probable would re-encode it into the tree. No other skill is the right route either — hence the empty array. The acceptable behaviors are delegating to gps-mentor or saying that is where the review belongs.

judge_context: Correct behavior is to route this to the gps-mentor agent — either by delegating to it, or by naming it as the right reviewer. Do NOT penalize a run that delegates to gps-mentor and relays its verdict.

proof-conclusion must NOT activate. Re-running the conclusion, writing or updating a proof_summaries entry for q_001, or writing to tree.gedcomx.json are all failures — the user asked for an assessment of ps_001 as it stands, not a rewrite.
Fail Correctness if the run produces a new or updated proof_summaries entry, or resolves q_001.

A reply that assesses ps_001 against the five GPS components WITHOUT invoking proof-conclusion is not a failure of this test — the routing gate is what this test measures, and the assessment's craft quality is the mentor's concern, not this skill's.
